limits: One actual append role active at killed worker; no external exactly-once guarantee.

native_qualification: Operational campaign preceded later unsupported-SDK-payload error handling, UTF-8 error truncation, cold association inspection and scheduling abandonment. retained_probes.qualification: Archived same-name/version SDK was incorrectly built into current target, causing stale metadata linkage. Copied old binaries aside; package-only Cargo cleanup and current rebuild resolved it. Final complete regression passed. Docs require separate archived target.

A contended 300ms heartbeat smoke expired safely. Replaced ordinary heartbeat smoke with a 1s lease/2.4s observation; production native/load uses 10s. No contended short-TTL guarantee. Initial compile corrections are not runtime acceptance.

invariants: Exact task payload and worker host contracts are immutable; workflow preview and original saved task definitions must agree.
Queue claims/occupancy and renewable leases use database transactions/time. Runtime writes and dispatch verify queue and runtime fences before commit.
Generation reservations commit before dispatch. Zero-price cancelled/unknown attempts still occupy the scoped generation quota.
Failed/Waiting/Paused work never auto-retries. Expired Running recovery retains original uncertain effects; observed operator reconciliation does not authorize replay.
Authenticated host roles and scope replace claimed actors. Queue-enabled remote routes cannot bypass admission even while admission is disabled.
Scheduling abandonment requires exact open revision and no live queue/runtime owners; it releases scheduling only, preserving budgets, sessions and unknown effects.
Explicit SQL schema v3 migration preserves dataset identity/records, refuses live leases and fences old binaries. Use a separate target directory when building archived SDK copies.
limits: Finite single-host local acceptance, not production SLO, distributed-network partition acceptance, simultaneous GPU inference or universal external exactly-once effects.
Four-process throughput uses explicitly offline fixture models; native campaign is separate and does not establish research/semantic/long-task quality or framework leadership.
Roles/revocations apply at request time; accepted jobs require explicit cancellation to stop. Control acknowledgement persists delivery, not immediate callback completion.
No forced graceful-shutdown deadline: active callbacks may wait their configured timeout. Hard-stop requires retained journals and lease expiry.
Bounded payload/history/claim/inspection/namespace capacities refuse oversize inputs. No automatic pruning, calendar quota reset, per-user billing or currency conversion.
Native MCP append and notes_status are controlled owned service examples; production connectors require their own effect/reconciliation guarantees.
Actual old-v2 lease blocks upgrade and old inspection rejects v3; old-binary native dispatch and rolling upgrades were not tested.
P0 complex/long/PEER effectiveness, independent semantic/factual assessment and default embedding negative-query acceptance remain open.
